decisions.statement: A file the addon's table cannot be read out of reads as no request.
A file setting the addon's table to nil reads as no request.
A request names each domain once.
The domains a request names are written in alphabetical order.
A request naming no domain asks the addon to collect every domain again.
A written request has a version above the version the last request had.
A written request has a version at least as high as the clock reads.
A written request opens with a line saying no hand edits the file.
An empty Lua table read where a domain list was asked for reads as an empty list.

definition: the request the catalog addon reads, taken out of Lua and written back as Lua
